LanguageData.AM_Assumptions: Assumptions: current diets, policies and access persist. Feeding order is staged: humans first eat food animals cannot use, then shared food; animals eat today's pen growth first, then plants already standing in the pen, then stored feed. Seasonal pen growth uses vanilla quadrum estimates, set to zero at modeled freezing temperature; unused daily growth is not carried over and standing plants are not replenished. Forecast allocation can differ from game AI. No automatic feeding or slaughter.
LanguageData.AM_Invalidation: Recalculate after pen/door/area or food policy changes, births/deaths, migration or stock changes. Raids, weather anomalies, handler feeding of animals and future maturation are not modeled. Grazers outside pens are excluded from the forecast. Estimates remain uncertain, especially when partial.
LanguageData.AM_Stale: Settings changed or snapshot absent: recalculate.
LanguageData.AM_Failed: Calculation failed; any earlier snapshot is stale and must not be used as a current forecast.
LanguageData.AM_Scan: Snapshot tick {0}; calculation {1} ms / {2} access checks (not a TPS measurement)
LanguageData.AM_NoPopulationBaseline: Birth/death scenario omitted: no existing species population to extrapolate.
LanguageData.AM_Spoilage: Modeled stock nutrition lost to spoilage: {0}
LanguageData.AM_NutritionAssumptions: Demand uses each pawn's fed consumption rate, not the slower rate shown while hungry. Stocks use the minimum eater-specific nutrition among verified consumers. Prisoners and downed colonists are assumed to be served from food a free colonist can reach; babies are assumed breastfed while a lactating colonist is present. Spoilage uses seasonal outdoor temperature or maintained current room temperature; food expiring during a day is conservatively excluded for that day. Temperature control failure, processing and future deliveries invalidate the projection.
